metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use Sentinel-2 data (good resolution for snow cover) for two dates: October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018. - Location: Southern Siberia (approximately 50-55°N, 80-110°E). - Calculate Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) or use snow probability for both dates. - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR); higher values indicate snow. 2. **Masking strategy**: - Mask clouds using the QA60 band (Sentinel-2 standard). - We need valid pixels for both dates to compare. - Use at least 1000m scale to reduce timeout risk. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both dates have valid NDSI values; compare mean NDSI. If NDSI increases → A, else → B. - C1: No images found for one or both dates. - C2: Images exist but 0 valid pixels after cloud masking. - C3: NDSI values are NaN or invalid (e.g., > 1 or < -1). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define southern Siberia region const siberia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([80, 50, 110, 55]); // 2. Sentinel-2 collection with cloud mask function const maskClouds = (image) => { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return image.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))); }; // 3. Get images for October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018 const col14 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(siberia) .filterDate('2018-10-14', '2018-10-15') .map(maskClouds); const col29 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(siberia) .filterDate('2018-10-29', '2018-10-30') .map(maskClouds); const size14 = col14.size().getInfo(); const size29 = col29.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 14 Images: ${size14}, Oct 29 Images: ${size29}`); // 4. Check if we have data if (size14 === 0 || size29 === 0) { console.log('No data found for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) const calcNDSI = (img) => { const green = img.select('B3'); const swir = img.select('B11'); const ndsi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('NDSI'); return img.addBands(ndsi); }; const img14 = col14.map(calcNDSI).median(); const img29 = col29.map(calcNDSI).median(); // 6. Calculate pixel counts and mean NDSI const stats14 = img14.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), null, true), geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats29 = img29.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), null, true), geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count14 = stats14['NDSI_count']; const mean14 = stats14['NDSI_mean']; const count29 = stats29['NDSI_count']; const mean29 = stats29['NDSI_mean']; console.log(`Oct 14: Mean NDSI=${mean14?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count14}`); console.log(`Oct 29: Mean NDSI=${mean29?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count29}`); // 7. Validation checks if (count14 === 0 || count29 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean14 === null || mean14 === undefined || mean29 === null || mean29 === undefined || isNaN(mean14) || isNaN(mean29)) { console.log('NDSI calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare snow cover (higher NDSI = more snow) const increase = mean29 > mean14; console.log(`Snow cover change: ${(mean29 - mean14).toFixed(4)}`); if (increase) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
